known_limitations: The MTEB AppsRetrieval artifact is a metric report; query-level top-10 predictions are exported separately.
The test-only dataset provides no legitimate train/dev relevance labels for learning a reranker.
Predictions cover the official test queries and are not an interactive evaluation service.
